summary: SafeVault Phase 2 Sprint 3 (Upload & Download integration) verified. Static-inspected all 6 required files against spec — all pass: SyncState type + syncState/syncError fields on VaultDocument; UploadQueue key 'safevault.upload.queue.v1' with full API + withLock() serialisation + enqueue defaults; UploadCoordinator singleton with submit/processQueue/retryAll/cancelForDoc, BACKOFF_STEPS_MS=[2s,5s,15s,60s], RETRY_INTERVAL_MS=30_000, correct submit flow (encrypt → saveEncryptedLocal → sqlite.upsertDocument → UploadQueue.enqueue → attemptOne), failure path increments attempts and keeps item queued, cancelForDoc removes queue entries and deletes cipher files, events broadcast via subscribe; documentContent cache-first with SHA-256 verifyIntegrity (integrity mismatch never throws, only warns), sha256OfBase64 uses CryptoJS.enc.Base64.parse + SHA256; VaultContext refactored to route addDoc via UploadCoordinator.submit, useEffect wires setUser + subscribes to patch docs[] and persist via storage.setDocs, deleteDoc calls cancelForDoc before Drive delete, buildSeed marks all seeded docs syncState='synced'; no direct encryptBase64/getKey/uploadToDrive/saveEncryptedLocal imports remain in VaultContext; app/document/[id].tsx imports getDocumentContent + useAuth and integrityWarning triggers a non-blocking Alert. VaultCtx public API surface unchanged. `npx tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck` exit 0. Frontend Metro bundle clean (only pre-existing shadow*/expo-notifications/Premature close warnings). E2E on http://localhost:8081 (420x900) passes: splash → login-demo-btn → onboarding-continue-btn → priority-reminder-card visible → tab-docs shows 6 seeded docs with Valid/Expiring/Expired/No expiry badges. All regression testIDs present (tab-home/timeline/docs/profile/add-fab, docs-sort-row, doc-card-*). No runtime console errors. Wrote 3 in-process test files under /app/frontend/__tests__/: uploadQueue.test.mjs (7/7 pass), uploadCoordinator.test.mjs (4/4 pass — success path clears queue and emits pending-upload→uploading→synced, failure retains queue with status='failed' + attempts=1 + emits 'pending-upload' since attempts<5, submit never rejects on upload failure, cancelForDoc removes item and emits 'deleted'), documentContent.test.mjs (5/5 pass — verified=true on match, verified=false+warning on mismatch, verified=false+no warning when fileHash undefined/null). Total 16/16 in-process assertions pass.
critical_code_review_comments: uploadCoordinator.attemptOne emits state 'synced' at progress=1 and 'pending-upload' on failure while attempts<5 — matches spec, but note: users cannot see 'failed' state until 5 consecutive attempts; consider surfacing a persistent 'retrying' badge on the doc card when syncState='pending-upload' + syncError!=null (out of Sprint 3 scope but worth Sprint 4 UX polish).

VaultContext subscribe handler persists via storage.setDocs on every event (including 'uploading' progress frames). While upload progress currently isn't emitted through subscribe listener state patches on progress<1 (state='uploading'), high-frequency progress events could cause AsyncStorage write amplification. Consider filtering ev.state==='uploading' with progress<1 out of the setDocs persistence path.

getDocumentContent computes SHA-256 by reading the entire base64 into a CryptoJS WordArray — fine for typical documents (<10MB) but will spike memory on large files; document a size cap or streaming plan for Sprint 5.
seed_data_creation: Uses existing 6-doc buildSeed inside VaultContext (Passport, Health Insurance, Driving License, Car Insurance, Life Insurance – Maya, School Records – Aarav)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint 3 fully green. In-process __tests__/*.mjs are standalone (no jest / no expo) — run with `node --experimental-vm-modules /app/frontend/__tests__/<file>.test.mjs`. Sprint 4 will introduce SyncManager (reconnect trigger + manual 'Sync now'); at that point the coordinator's internal setInterval(30s) retry loop should be gated by SyncManager. Web preview will continue to show 'Local cache unavailable' behaviour because expo-file-system isn't available on web (Sprint 1 constraint). VaultCtx public API surface is unchanged from Sprint 2 — safe to build on top.
